title: Garden Attendant
subtitle: Tending the Scholar's Garden
bodyText: A garden attendant waters specimens and notices the small changes of another growing day. Patient care keeps living examples within reach, giving the school's larger questions roots in plants that can be observed.
sceneBrief: A modest garden attendant waters or tends several plant specimens in a Greek courtyard garden; simple tunic, no master scholar's collection of instruments.
rarityCharacteristics: plain iron, single rule, square corner joints
